subject: Mutual Action Plan: Cleanroom POC provisioning & activation commitments
messages:
From: Alice Tanner <alice.tanner@cleansys.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@cleansys.health>, security@cleansys.health
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cleanroom POC - MAP kickoff and environment commitments

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the walkthrough today. Per our conversation, attaching the initial MAP spreadsheet with the columns we discussed (owner, dependency, target date). We want the POC to be able to run with a small set of synthetic workloads and a single model endpoint behind VPC peering by end of next week.

Top asks from my side:
- API keys and tenant/org creation for our staging team (dev@cleansys.health) — scoped to read-only metrics + write for test tokens
- IP allowlist block for our staging CIDR (34.82.128.0/24) and the peering route to our VPC
- A straightforward VPC peering template (routing, security groups) we can hand to infra

Attaching: RDW_Cleansys_MAP_v1.xlsx — fill in owners and we’ll sign off on dates.

Alice
Product Ops | Cleansys Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tanner <alice.tanner@cleansys.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleanroom POC - MAP kickoff and environment commitments

Alice —

Thanks, this looks good. I’ve populated the MAP with initial delivery owners and dates (see attached). Quick clarifications below so our infra team can start the provisioning template work: 

1) Org/tenant model: do you want a single Cleansys tenant with multiple teams (staging, analytics) or separate tenants per team? For the POC we recommend a single tenant with two sub-teams to simplify keying and quotas.
2) API key policy: we will create scoped keys for staging (test only) that expire after 90 days unless you request otherwise. Are there any extra KMS/HSM requirements for this tenant?
3) Peering target: confirm your VPC name/tag and the primary subnet range for the peer (you mentioned 10.40.16.0/24 in the call; your email has 34.82.x.x for allowlist — we want the routing CIDR for peering rules).

I’ve looped in Neha and Ben to start the peering template and apikey provisioning steps.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_Cleansys_MAP_v1.xlsx, apikey-provisioning-sample.txt
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cleanroom POC - peering template draft

Forwarding my draft peering template to start discussion.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: vpc-peering-params-template.txt
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Ben — quick notes in the template: required route tables, recommended security group rules (allow outbound 443 to Redwood egress; block other ranges), and a short checklist for NAT/egress if Cleansys needs to call out to public internet. Also added a validation step for prefix overlap.

Suggested timeline (for SLT):
- Day 0 (today): MAP owners set and initial templates shared
- Day 1–2: Cleansys confirms CIDRs + tenant model
- Day 3–5: Redwood provisions tenant + test API keys and shares key manifest (secure link)
- Day 6–7: Peering configured, route tables accepted, IP allowlist enacted
- Day 8–10: Smoke test with synthetic workload, latency/cost snapshot, and joint signoff

I’ll post the template to the shared Drive and add comments.

Neha
Infra & Deployment Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: vpc-peering-params-template.txt
From: Alice Tanner <alice.tanner@cleansys.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@cleansys.health>, security@cleansys.health
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleanroom POC - MAP kickoff and environment commitments

Rachel / Neha —

Thanks for the rapid draft. Confirming the peering CIDR: our peering subnet is 10.40.16.0/24 (apologies for the confusion earlier — 34.82.x.x was our egress testing pool and should be used for allowlisting only). We prefer a single tenant with team scoping.

Security notes from our side:
- Keys must be rotated every 90 days for the POC (we can accept 90-day rotation cadence).
- We need an audit log export (token-level) for the trial window (7 days of retention for the POC).

I’ve updated the attached MAP with owners for the infra validations column. We can sign the MAP once you update the tenant details. If we can get test keys by Tuesday morning (PST), we’ll aim to run our smoke tests Wed–Thu.

Alice
Product Ops | Cleansys Health

Attachments: RDW_Cleansys_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Tanner <alice.tanner@cleansys.health>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 09 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cleanroom POC - MAP kickoff and environment commitments

Hi Alice —

We’ve provisioned a Cleansys staging tenant (cleansys-stg.redwood) and generated three scoped API keys for your staging team. Keys are staged in a secure manifest (link below) and will expire after 90 days; we’ve enabled rotation reminders.

Quick summary of what I did: 
- Tenant: cleansys-stg.redwood (org id: org_7721)
- Scoped API keys: staging-team-key-1 (read/write test), analytics-key-1 (read-only metrics), smoke-key-1 (ephemeral for smoke tests)
- IP allowlist: added 34.82.128.0/24 for Redwood egress testing and configured inbound rule for Cleansys peer 10.40.16.0/24
- VPC peering: template applied; Cleansys must accept peering on their side (routing patch id: rp-88c3).

Smoke test checklist (what we’ll validate once they accept peering):
- Successful handshake and route visibility from both sides
- Token exchange acceptance and basic inference latency under 300ms for sample payload
- Audit log export available for token-level queries (7-day window)

Secure manifest link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/cleansys/keys-manifest (access granted to alice.tanner@cleansys.health and samir@cleansys.health)

If Cleansys confirms acceptance by Monday EOD, we can hit the target smoke-test window Wed–Thu. Marissa — can you open a short post-mortem template so we capture latency/cost numbers for the trial?

Ben
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: apikey-provisioning-sample.txt, vpc-peering-params-template.txt
